name: logger-ring
description: The logger@1 SINK `ring`: a bounded in-memory ring of the last Messages, published as the `logs` service and readable through GET/POST routes on the web seam (works with no web provider loaded; only the read routes are conditional).

level.description: Threshold: error | warn | info | debug (name or ordinal). Default info.

path.description: Route base path of the read surface (default /api/logs)

routes.description: Register the read routes when the web seam is present (default true)
